subject: SOC2 / DPA / Pen-test — evening evidence handback & buffer request
messages:
From: Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@gridline.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procure@gridline.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — evening window?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for taking this on. Our procurement and security teams want to run the vendor-led penetration test next week and do a combined walkthrough covering SOC 2 controls, the DPA redlines, and the pen-test scope. Procurement specifically asked whether Redwood can accommodate an evening handback window — they want a 60-minute buffer after the live test to stage evidence transfer and finalize signatures before close of business in our APAC office.

High-level ask: can your ops/security team hold a slot between 18:00–21:00 PT on either Jan 26 or Jan 28 (we're flexible) with the following:
- 90 minutes total (walkthrough + Q&A)
- 60-minute evidence handback buffer after the live pen activity
- A fallback plan in case the test runs long (procurement prefers DocuSign ID or SFTP token exchange)

I've attached our DPA scope and the vendor's checklist. Pen-test vendor contact is Tariq Amin (tariq.amin@redtestlab.io) — he will be on the call for the live run.

Attachments: DPA_Scopes_v2.pdf (procurement), pen-test-checklist.xlsx (vendor)

Can you confirm availability and any constraints? If evening support is hard, please propose an alternate plan that preserves the 60-min buffer.

Best,
Sarah Kelly
Senior Procurement Manager
Gridline Financial
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@gridline.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 18:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — evening window?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the attachments. We can support an evening window; a few clarifications and a suggested plan below.

Proposed options (pick one):
- Option A: Jan 26, 18:30–20:00 PT (90 min walkthrough + immediate 60-min evidence staging after the session)
- Option B: Jan 28, 19:00–20:30 PT (same structure)

Operational notes / asks from our side:
- Please confirm Tariq's expected start time for the live test and whether the test vendor will be performing active exploitation during that 90-min block or if the live run is separate. If the test is live during our walkthrough, we need a 15-min pre-call to confirm bridge handoff.
- For the evidence handback buffer: procurement's preferred mechanism is DocuSign for DPA signatures + SFTP/temporary pre-signed S3 URLs for evidence upload. If Procurement has a DocuSign ID ready, paste it here and we'll route it to Legal for a rapid sign.
- Can you share the vendor's jumpbox / bridge details or whether they'll proxy via our shared ops bridge? We can host a temporary satellite bridge if their tooling doesn't play nicely with our environment.

Fallback plan: if the pen run overruns, we can pause the walkthrough, allow the vendor to finish, then reconvene for an evidence-only 30–45 minute Handoff within 24 hours. That preserves procurement's staging window.

Olga (security) and Ben (sales) are looped for staffing and procurement coordination. Laura (CS) will own the evidence-transfer steps and post-call follow-up.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Trust & Safety (Redwood Inference)

Markus / Ben — quick ops coordination:

We can staff an evening pair for either date. Suggested internal staffing: Olga (controls lead) + Markus (on-call T&S) with Ben standing by for procurement escalation; Laura to coordinate S3/SFTP handoff.

Technical notes:
- If Tariq needs to run active exploitation, request they use a vendor jumpbox and notify us 24 hrs prior so we can provision temporary logging and scoped access.
